paper_id: Precise Learning of Source Code Contextual Semantics via Hierarchical Dependence Structure and Graph Attention Networks
title: Precise Learning of Source Code Contextual Semantics via Hierarchical Dependence Structure and Graph Attention Networks
motivation: 现有AST模型捕获语法但无法提取隐式上下文依赖；CFG模型虽能提供上下文依赖，但无法有效表示基本块内部信息
problem_framing: 如何构建同时融合AST语法结构和CFG上下文依赖的分层源码模型，以精确学习代码语义
key_insight: 每个CFG基本块对应一个AST子树——基本块的AST结构差异（如null vs NO_FIELDS）比词频更能捕捉语义区别
method_signature: MFGNN双层网络：TBCNN提取基本块局部特征，AGN4D（有向多类型边图注意力）学习上下文特征
evaluation_criteria: 程序分类准确率/F1、缺陷预测AUC、F1、代码克隆检测准确率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: BoW等文本特征严重依赖词频，无法有效捕捉代码间的细微语义差异
evidence_for_taste: basic blocks, which are the basis of contextual dependencies, are paid little attention
these methods only utilize the textual features, which significantly relies on the frequency
cannot effectively capture the difference shown in Figure 1
the learning of these two words (null and NO_FIELDS) is uneven
the basic blocks should be prioritized
a proper source code model should introduce semantic differences
subtle grammatical differences, are represented by the structural differences of the AST
thinking_moves: 从缺陷样例反推模型应捕获执行路径和语义差异
先定义基本块表示为何不足，再提出AST子树的解决方案
分层处理：先局部后上下文，先树后图
扩展GAT支持有向边和多类型边以适应CFG
调整TBCNN权重使深层节点信息更显著
